attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: weather_api_formatting

steps:
  - id: fetch_weather
    op: api_call
    params:
      service: weather_api
      endpoint: /current
      method: GET
      query_params:
        location: "{{ trigger.location }}"
    output: raw_weather_data

  - id: format_weather
    op: transform
    params:
      input: "{{ raw_weather_data }}"
      template: |
        Weather for {{ raw_weather_data.location.name }}, {{ raw_weather_data.location.region }}
        -----------------------------------------------
        Condition:   {{ raw_weather_data.current.condition }}
        Temperature: {{ raw_weather_data.current.temp_f }}°F / {{ raw_weather_data.current.temp_c }}°C
        Feels Like:  {{ raw_weather_data.current.feelslike_f }}°F / {{ raw_weather_data.current.feelslike_c }}°C
        Humidity:    {{ raw_weather_data.current.humidity }}%
        Wind:        {{ raw_weather_data.current.wind_mph }} mph {{ raw_weather_data.current.wind_dir }}
        Updated:     {{ raw_weather_data.current.last_updated }}
      format: plain_text
    output: formatted_weather_display
